text:
Unleashes built-up cold energy in a violent surge, dealing Magic Damage and inflicting Frozen on nearby enemies.
Charging the skill alters both its range and DMG.
Tier 1: Chants for 1s, targeting an 8m frontal cone.
Tier 2: Chants for 2s, targeting an 8m frontal cone with 50% increased DMG.
Tier 3: Chants for 3s, targeting an 8m frontal cone with 100% increased DMG.
When holding 1/3/5 Frost Crystal, the skill will instantly cast at Tier 1/2/3, skipping the charge time.

Tips: This skill offers both area damage and crowd control. For best results, cast it when you have high Frost Crystal count.

Consumes 15 Ice Energy to launch a concentrated ice beam toward the target, dealing Magic Damage to all enemies in its path every 0.3s. After dealing DMG 5 instances, the beam attempts to consume additional Ice Energy to sustain itself. Every 12 Ice Energy extends the beam by 0.3s and deals 1 additional instance of DMG. Each time Frostbeam deals DMG, it increases its own DMG by 8%, up to 80%. (Terminates when Ice Energy drops below 3.)
Frostbeam's firing interval is affected by Haste.

Tips: Cast when Ice Energy is near maximum capacity for extended beam duration. While firing, use the joystick to make minor positioning adjustments.

After dealing 6 instances of DMG, gains 1 stack of Battle Will.
Battle Will: A manifestation of fierce will. Grants a Shield upon gaining, with 20% base DMG Reduction.

Pro Tips: Keep up continuous DMG to maintain the shield effect and stack Battle Will.

Consumes 40 Energy to channel the power of forest for 4s, healing the caster and up to 10 nearby allies over time (party members prioritized). Healing scales with the caster's MATK (plus an additional fixed amount equal to 15% of the target's Max HP), and healing targets also gain 15% All Element Resistance for 10s.

Tips: A strong healing skill for high-pressure moments. Since it requires channeling, time your cast carefully.

Unleashes vines, inflicting Stun on surrounding enemies while dealing Magic DMG, and restoring HP to friendly targets around you.

Tips: This is an instant cast skill. Paired with Lifebind Spec talents, it provides good damaging and healing capabilities in combats requiring continuous movement.

Consumes 30 Energy to summon giant vines that strike a target area, dealing Magic DMG and healing the caster and the nearby ally with the lowest HP (Party Members Prioritized). Healing grows with MATK.

Tips: In emergencies, cast repeatedly for fast healing. Otherwise, use Basic Attacks to stack Regen Buds, which improves both healing and DMG.

Quickly slashes horizontally with a scythe condensed from lightning, dealing <style="physical">Attack DMG</style> equal to <style="accent-gn">300%</style>ATK to the enemy, which scales with the Level/Tier of <style="accent-gn">Thundercut</style>.

Backsteps with a wide sweep, dealing Rock DMG and entering a charge stance. Tap again or wait to unleash two dashing strikes, dealing Rock DMG.
In the charge stance, you can use [Dragon Slash]

Pro Tips: You can dodge to interrupt the backstep and avoid incoming DMG. precise hit after modification can instantly restore Energy.

Channels for 6s and continuously spews searing flames forward, dealing Magic DMG equal to 1000% ATK in total to the enemies within range.

Tips: Move continuously and try to maximize DMG dealt while staying safe.

Thunder Traverse
Unleashes a relentless stream of Thunder Tracers that track enemies and deal Thunder Element damage on impact. Hold the skill button to continue the barrage, consuming the heat gauge to extend its duration.

Pro Tips: Best used when fully charged-hold the skill to unleash an overwhelming barrage for dealing massive DMG.

Grants 45% additional DMG Reduction and Super Armor for 10s.

This skill is unaffected by CD effects.

Summons Boss: Inferno Ogre to unleash a forward fiery breath, dealing Attack DMG to the target. The damage dealt heals the caster and applies additional DMG reduction (this attribute is triggered up to a maximum of 50%).

Skill is not affected by CD.

Summons Fafala to create a field. The caster and allies within the field gain additional DMG reduction (this attribute is triggered up to a maximum of 50%) and Super Armor.
(Cannot be stacked; only one instance of the same effect can be active.)

Skill is not affected by CD.

Activates and amplifies the Battlelust aura, drastically reducing the movement speed and DEF of all enemies in the area. All allies within the range gain greatly increased DEF and are healed every 3s.

Channels the power of the stars, entering Star Calling state. While active, greatly increases your Sigil chance and grants Sigil: Falling Star.
Sigil: When DMG is dealt, there is chance to summon 1 meteor to bombard the target area, dealing area damage. More meteors are summoned based on your Sigil chance. This effect has a CD, which - your Sigil chance.

Transforms into Boss: Brigand Leader and summons a blazing giant axe, increasing the party's ATK within range for a period and granting yourself additional ATK boost.
(This effect cannot stack and only one can be active at a time.)

Summons Boss: Storm Goblin King to release a meteor shower at the target, dealing Magic DMG. Upon the skill cast, your Luck and DMG dealt and healing of Luck effects are increased for a period.
Tier 5: While active, trigger​ all unlocked ​passive Luck effects​ from your Plains Battle Imagines.

Summons Boss: Basilisk to spin toward the target, dealing Attack DMG.
After casting, grants an All-Element Bonus to you and up to 10 nearby allies (prioritizing teammates) for a period of time.
(Cannot be affected by the same type of effect within 60s)

Resonates with the power from Elite Void Ogre and roars on the spot, launching 6 wildly dancing Void Corruption energy substances at the target, dealing <style="physical">Attack DMG</style>. Applies Void Corruption Decay to the target for <style="accent-gn">10s</style>, dealing <style="magic">Magic DMG</style> per second, stacks up to <style="accent-gn">5</style> times. <style="accent-gn">100%</style>of the DoT dealt restores your HP.
Retract arms, gather strength, and throw the adventurer like a meteor!
Paddles vigorously and dashes a short distance instantly!
Enables auto-track and navigate in open terrain.

Begins swinging and summons a taiyaki to the front. Picking it up grants a special effect. Using the skill again stops the swinging.

Taiyaki: Reduces the CD of Catapult Acceleration by 30% and briefly increases Movement Speed.
After casting, dash forward to gain additional Rapid Energy and greatly increase Movement Speed.
Detonate the sound wave! Upon casting, instantly resets Musical Glide's CD. For a short time afterwards, successive casts of Musical Glide won't trigger CD.

Summons a Nappo Supervisor.
The Nappo Supervisor detects Stalkers within 25m, sounds an alarm, and moves toward the target.
If no Stalkers are in range, it moves randomly.
<style="emph-gn">Identifies</style> nearby Stalkers, causing them to be <style="physical">tracked</style> on radar and briefly disabling their transformation skills.
